answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks through bonded staking with automated slashing. Each participant locks native capital in an onyx registry contract to withstand a gale of forged handshakes. The attacker incurs the verifiable cost of forfeited liquidity for every malicious identity detected. While a jade credential validates bonded peers, this approach inherently disadvantages resource-poor agents while allowing wealthy adversaries to purchase undue influence.
